items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: George Clark played tenor saxophone, and Jonah Jones played the trumpet. He was in that band.

ctx.x: Who did you have in that group, can you remember?

I had a saxophone player by the name of Percy France, a genius player, very wonderful player. And I had a drummer by the name of Danny Farrar, spelled F-a-r-r-a-r. He later went with Jonah Jones for awhile, good drummer, played with good feeling. And that was very exciting experience. And from there I had the pleasure of going to Europe with Buck Clayton and his fine group.
That was a wonderful band Buck had,
